otherData.semantics: Each slice is the min(start)..max(end) envelope of ranges with the same role, aligned name, and payload. IKET timestamps are software annotation arrival times, not async completion times. The 2cta SDP_ISSUE(i,k) slices are explicitly marked as derived software issue intervals in their args. Tile completion_us is the last annotated REDUCE range end, not atomic retire, GMEM visibility, or strict stage recycle completion.

inputs.selection_semantics: Only events belonging to the selected i range are retained; their trailing work is kept through completion. Unindexed startup events are retained only before the next-cycle anchor.
inputs.tile_timing_semantics: completion_us is the last annotated REDUCE range end for the selected H128 tile. It is a software trace boundary, not atomic retire, GMEM visibility, or strict stage recycle completion.
